Erasure operates as a decentralized data curation and sharing protocol built on the Ethereum blockchain. Erasure uses its own token to support staking and curation of data offers. Erasure is designed for peer-to-peer data marketplaces without a central intermediary.

UMA functions as an optimistic oracle that answers price and event requests from smart contracts on public blockchains. UMA relies on a dispute process in which token holders can challenge assertions, with disputes resolved by its data verification mechanism. UMA is governed by holders of the UMA governance token. UMA supports the creation of synthetic assets and prediction-style financial contracts.

Balancer operates as an automated market maker and decentralized exchange on the Ethereum blockchain. Balancer supports liquidity pools that can hold multiple tokens with custom weights. Balancer is governed through its BAL governance token. Balancer uses a shared vault architecture to hold pooled assets in V2.

InstaDApp provides a DeFi interface and aggregator on the Ethereum blockchain. InstaDApp offers users a smart contract account, known as DeFi Smart Account, that connects to multiple lending and borrowing protocols. InstaDApp supports flash loans for executing multi-step DeFi transactions in a single operation. InstaDApp has its own INST governance token.

Sablier operates as a token streaming protocol on public blockchains that enables continuous, per-second payments. Sablier represents payment streams as non-fungible tokens in its V2 version. Sablier supports linear streams and lockup schedules for vesting and payroll use cases. Sablier is a non-custodial protocol that releases funds to recipients without an intermediary.
